task_instance: In a fresh create-expo-app (blank-typescript) project with no existing theme, build the design system this skill defines: a src-less theme/ folder (colors.ts, spacing.ts, typography.ts, radius.ts, shadows.ts, motion.ts, index.ts) using the exact patterns from the skill (Color from expo-router wrapped in Platform.select for semantic colors, a 4pt spacing scale, a named typography ramp, radius/shadow/motion scales), plus reusable components/ (ThemedText, Button with variant/size/state/style-override/accessibility contract), and wire App.tsx to consume them (screens import components; components import tokens) instead of hardcoded styles.
evidence: Scaffolded app with `npx create-expo-app@latest MyApp --template blank-typescript --no-install`, then `npm install` (467 packages) plus `npm install expo-router react-native-safe-area-context react-native-screens` to get the `Color` API the skill's colors.ts example imports from 'expo-router' (confirmed real export at node_modules/expo-router/build/color/index.d.ts: `export declare const Color: ColorType` with `.ios`/`.android.dynamic` fields matching the skill's usage exactly). Wrote theme/colors.ts, spacing.ts, typography.ts, radius.ts, shadows.ts, motion.ts, index.ts and components/themed-text.tsx, components/button.tsx verbatim per the skill's code samples, added a `@/*` path alias in tsconfig.json, and rewrote App.tsx to import ThemedText/Button/tokens instead of raw StyleSheet values (screens import components; components import tokens, per the skill's rule). Verified with `npx tsc --noEmit` against the full project (strict mode) -> zero errors (TSC_OK). All 9 theme/component files exist under /tmp/claude-0/.../MyApp/theme and /tmp/claude-0/.../MyApp/components, and App.tsx at /tmp/claude-0/.../MyApp/App.tsx renders Button in primary/secondary/loading states via the shared variant/size contract. A separate attempt to also bundle for web (`npx expo export --platform web`) hit react-native-web@0.21 requiring React 19.3 vs the template's React 19.2.3 (unrelated peer-dependency version skew, not a design-system or runtime limitation) and an outbound telemetry call blocked by the proxy (also non-essential, informational only) — neither affects the actual deliverable, which is the design system's source and its type-correctness, both verified.
